quick_theorem.elimination_rule: If k == 0 mod 4 then theta_k=1, so all character twists on this ordinary split presentation are baseline and SU(2)_k is eliminated for this cheap test.
quick_theorem.signal_rule: If k is not 0 mod 4 then some character twists are nonbaseline.
quick_theorem.statement: For SU(2)_k, the nontrivial universal character is parity. Let theta_k be the twist of the invertible simple object k. For CP2#2CPbar with split framings (+1,-1,-1), the character twist alpha=(alpha_h,alpha_e1,alpha_e2) has value equal to the untwisted baseline times theta_k^(-alpha_h+alpha_e1+alpha_e2).
